correctness.rationale: For every even N≥4, the norm is the maximum of the N facet support functionals, and outside the unit ball in an active facet cone DR(x)=(I−u⊗φ)/r. Convexity over a facet reduces its induced norm to endpoints; the exact determinant representation P_t h=det(u_t,h)e/sin(2π/N) makes the norm a vertex maximization. The chord gauge and maximum vertex determinant differ with N mod4, yielding sec²(π/N) for 4|N and 1 for N≡2 mod4. Piecewise differentiability and segment integration promote this to the global Lipschitz bound; approach a facet vertex externally for sharpness. In the expansive case each strict facet interior has smaller operator norm and no finite distinct pair attains it; quarter-turn vertex directions attain the limiting derivative. Direct independent facet/vertex calculations for N=4,6,8,10,12 reproduce values 2,1,4−2√2,1,8−4√3.
